pages.text: $(bold)Start here.$()$(br2)Post or snowy village → research station → awakening and first consume → Evolved and convoy → hive and Hydra → Futian pump → underground den.$(br2)Use /blacklightguide for a lead based on your own progress.
Search the plains for an abandoned quarantine post. Take the cold-storage record from the booth barrel. Use it in the Overworld to obtain a station map. Keep the copper.
A snowy apprentice cartographer can sell a station map for a base price of 12 emeralds and a compass. At the red X, find the surface entrance and head downstairs.$(br2)$(l:lab)Next: cold storage$(/l)
